changes: Round 13: new grenade build — style source: lockbuilds 'Possibly Solved Venator Dopamine Maxxing' (Oct 18, 'Rush T2 Gutshot always into Ult into Nade Max'): Restorative Shot, Close Quarters, Battle Vest, Extra Health, Fortitude; mid Berserker, Hollow Point, Extra Charge, Recharging Rush, Ballistic Enchantment, Rapid Recharge, Vampiric Burst ('charge items timed for T3 nades'); Cultist route optional (taken: farm); late Silencer, Crippling Headshot, Siphon Bullets. Its Opening Rounds and Weakening Headshot are left out (Kieran dislikes Weakening Headshot; Cultist covers the gun spike). Kit: grenade 35 + 1.0x weapon damage, so Battle Vest, Hollow Point and Berserker feed it; it only gets charges at T3 and the trap has 2, so Extra Charge, Recharging Rush and Rapid Recharge come after grenade T3 (point 12). Order follows that build's text: Gutshot T2, then the ult, then grenade max: 2213244441112333. No hero-wide pick rates used.

Round 14: Cultist and Extra Charge notes emptied (Cultist's extra charge only lasts while its buff is up; the grenade is already T3 when Extra Charge is bought). Metal Skin note trimmed to the condition. Counters now sell Battle Vest and Ricochet sells Recharging Rush, so both T2s left in the last 12 have a named sell. Divine Barrier added to rich as Dispel Magic's pricier version.

Round 15: ability points 13-16 now trap T1-T3 before Gutshot T3 (2213244441113332). The mobalytics source for Gutshot T3 at 13 couldn't be re-checked, and by kit the trap wins: T3 adds a charge (feeds Extra Charge/Rapid Recharge) and +30% damage to revealed targets, while Gutshot T3 only blesses a heavy melee, which this build never uses. Points 1-12 still follow 'Rush T2 Gutshot always into Ult into Nade Max'.

Round 16: Restorative Shot (Kieran: only on shotgun heroes; Venator's gun fires 1 bullet) → High-Velocity Rounds: same 800 gun slot, +8% weapon damage feeds the grenade (35 + 1.0x weapon damage); it's the first half of Opening Rounds in the source build's early game. Still bought first and sold for Crippling Headshot. Spikes unchanged.

Round 17: made clearly grenade-focused: Berserker (shared with the gun build) → Compress Cooldown on Consecrating Grenade (Mid, after Hollow Point; Recharging Rush now before Extra Charge so Extra Charge still lands with the grenade at T3, 16.8k), upgraded to Superior Cooldown at the start of Late, so the grenade (25s, 20s with T1) comes back every ~13s and its charges refill faster, on top of Extra Charge/Rapid Recharge. Transcendent Cooldown added to Slot locked as its upgrade. Lane sell note standard; Divine Barrier note now 'If you bought Dispel Magic, sell it for this.'.

Round 18: made clearly different from the new Melee Venator and checked against post-Sep 16 grenade builds (lockbuilds 'Possibly Solved Venator Dopamine Maxxing' Oct 18, 'JonJon' Sep 23, 'GUNATOR' Oct 1): Compress/Superior Cooldown and Mystic Expansion out (in none of them; they are melee-build items), Berserker back in Mid (Dopamine), Siphon Bullets out for Inhibitor (in all 3), Transcendent Cooldown slot-locked box removed with Superior. Ability order now Dopamine's 2134224441113 then trap T2/T3, Gutshot T3 last (JonJon): 2134224441113332. Gun 4.8k at Cultist (4.8k), 8k on Berserker, health 4.8k on Fortitude (9.6k), grenade T3 before Extra Charge (17.6k). Moved to first: grenade is by far the most-played Venator style on lockbuilds.
Round 20: late list extended with Siphon Bullets, Spellslinger, Colossus (Goysenberg's late items); core+late 75.2k.

Round 23: Spellslinger out of the late list, Glass Cannon in (sells Hollow Point). Consecrating Grenade (35 + 1.0x weapon damage), Gutshot (60 + 0.7x, wall bonus 30 + 0.8x) and Ira Domini stakes (120 + 1.5x) scale with weapon damage, not fire rate, so +80% weapon damage raises all of them and the gun (33-round magazine).
Round 25: ability order 2134224441113332 -> 1123141322443423 (worked out from the kit for this build's playstyle).
Cost pass: Bullet Lifesteal added in Mid (mid-game sustain) so Vampiric Burst costs 1.6k less.
